title: Reopen withdraws an entry still waiting in QB Unexported
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, whose Close entry is waiting in QB Unexported.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Click "Reopen Work Order".
  5. Click Reopen Work Order in the window.
  6. Open QB Unexported in ShopView.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order".

Step 4:

  • The window opens.

Step 5:

  • The status reads "Complete".

Step 6:

  • The waiting row reads "Withdrawn: work order reopened" with no actions, and no reversal is sent.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-E1: “If the Close entry is still held in AccountingHub, Reopen withdraws it instead of posting a reversal; the row stays on Accounting Events with the status Dismissed and the reason "Withdrawn: work order reopened" (nothing was posted, so nothing is reversed). In QuickBooks, Reopen reverses only what was posted at Close, to the same accounts (S7-R5): an entry posted to the mapped account or to ShopView Review gets its reversal; an entry never sent (S7-N5) gets none; an entry still waiting in QB Unexported gets none, and its row is marked "Withdrawn: work order reopened". An entry Marked as Exported by hand counts as posted (S7-E2).”

From: Jira tickets under epic SV-11665 (saved 12 Nov 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11665-tickets-2026-11-12.md), read 12 Nov 2026

  • Jira SV-11977: “QB Unexported shows the classification, the category and the type (Internal Work Order Close, Internal Work Order Reopen, No Charge line), the Close's stock-part entries included; a row withdrawn by Reopen reads "Withdrawn: work order reopened" with no actions.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 500 (TP-029): “an entry still waiting in QB Unexported gets none and its row is marked "Withdrawn: work order reopened" with no Export / Mark as Exported actions”
  • Tech plan line 922 (TP-085): “withdrawn rows without actions, hand-exported counts as posted”
